paragraphs.source_en: 3 (p. 85) Noah and Lot . . . spare the righteous: God “spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness,” and “delivered just Lot, vexed with the filthy conversation of the wicked” (2 Peter 2:5, 2:7).

paragraphs.source_en: 4 (p. 85) Jonah: Like Noah and Lot, Jonah is a figure from the Old Testament. He was swallowed by a huge fish after being thrown overboard by sailors who were trying to appease Jehovah. Jonah survived in the belly of the fish for three days and then was delivered to dry land.
